//: Discussion on how to write comments in package.json:
name: wacz-validator-monorepo

scripts.check: pnpm run check:seaweedfs-pin && pnpm audit --audit-level=moderate && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/contract check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/core check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/validate-cli check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/protocol check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/daemon check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/devtools check && pnpm --filter @wacz-validator/tui check

//scripts: test:ui / test:report use the root vitest.config.ts, whose `projects` point at
the per-package configs — so the UI shows core, daemon and tui in one run rather
than needing three. `pnpm test` is unchanged and still goes through `pnpm -r test`.
test:report writes html/ and cannot be opened over file:// — serve it, e.g.
check:seaweedfs-pin fails when the SeaweedFS image in docker-compose.yml differs from the one
the seaweedfs submodule pins (seaweedfs/scripts/check-pin.sh). container-compose reads neither
include: nor extends:, so this service block is a copy and nothing else notices a stale one —
it sat on 4.23, which leaves an emptied bucket unwritable after a restart (upstream #9563).
//@types/node: interface augmentation — without it the VSCode TS LSP reports `Property
'dirname' does not exist on type 'ImportMeta'`. pnpm's default hoisting is
per-workspace, so @types/node already declared in packages/*/package.json
is NOT visible from the monorepo root; it must be a direct devDependency
here so a symlink lands at <root>/node_modules/@types/node.
